name: ifixit/php7-optional
description: Option and Result types for PHP: an alternative to null and to throwing

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the test suite, which also executes every docblock and README example
scripts-descriptions.psalm: Run psalm at errorLevel 1; it must exit 0, there is no baseline
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Run PHPStan at level max over src/ and the static-analysis code
scripts-descriptions.types: Assert what psalm and PHPStan infer for the expressions in tests/TypeInference
scripts-descriptions.benchmark: Measure what the box costs against the plain PHP it replaces
scripts-descriptions.mutation: Break the source on purpose and check a test notices; needs xdebug or pcov
scripts-descriptions.coverage: Measure line coverage and fail below the floor; needs xdebug or pcov
